base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your SAP system, without the service path. Example: https://my-sap-server.com or https://sandbox.api.sap.com/s4hanacloud. SAP API Hub

catalog_path.title: Catalog Path (Optional)
catalog_path.description: Path to SAP Service Catalog for browsing available services. Example: http/keboola/catalog

auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description: Authentication method for your SAP system. Basic (username/password) is the most common. SAP authentication docs

#password.title: Password
#password.description: Your SAP system password (encrypted and stored securely).

#api_key.title: API Key
#api_key.description: API key for authentication (encrypted and stored securely). Get your key at api.sap.com

api_key_header_name.title: API Key Header Name
api_key_header_name.description: HTTP header name for the API key. Typically APIKey (SAP API Hub) or X-API-Key (custom gateways).

token_url.title: Token URL
token_url.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint URL for client credentials flow.

#client_secret.title: Client Secret
#client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (encrypted and stored securely).

connection_options.title: Connection Options
connection_options.description: Override timeout, retries, and SSL settings. Leave empty to use defaults.

timeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum wait time for a SAP server response. Recommended: 60 s, for large extractions 120 s+.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Number of automatic retry attempts on transient failures (network issues, timeouts). Recommended: 3.

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL Certificates
verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates for HTTPS connections. Disable only for development with self-signed certificates.

pagination_defaults.title: Default Pagination Settings
pagination_defaults.description: Override default page size and record limit for all entities. Leave empty to use defaults (page size: 1000, unlimited records).

page_size.title: Default Page Size
page_size.description: Records per page for all entities (can be overridden per entity in row config). Recommended: 1000. OData docs

max_records.title: Default Max Records
max_records.description: Maximum records to fetch per entity (0 = unlimited). Useful for testing or cost control.
